page-mist.$description: Page Mist — Page canvas — the warm off-white that holds the entire site. Cards and content float on top of this

card-white.$description: Card White — Card surfaces, input fields, elevated panels — the brighter layer stacked above Page Mist

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text, body copy, headings, icons, link defaults. Slightly softer than pure black, warming the type against the off-white canvas

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, metadata (dates, bylines), footer labels, muted descriptions

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary text, image captions, disabled-adjacent labels

faint-line.$description: Faint Line — Hairline dividers, subtle borders between feed items and card edges

ash.$description: Ash — Placeholder text, low-emphasis labels, very muted helper copy

banner-cream.$description: Banner Cream — Top promotional bar background, soft warm callouts. The only non-violet warmth in the system

signal-violet.$description: Signal Violet — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

deep-iris.$description: Deep Iris — Pressed/hover state of Signal Violet, chromatic text emphasis, link text in article contexts. Sits one step darker on the same hue

hi-vis-yellow.$description: Hi-Vis Yellow — Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

labilvariable.$description: Display and heading face. Set at 40px for article hero titles and 25px for section headings, with aggressively wide tracking (up to 0.091em at display size). The wide letter-spacing is the single most recognizable typographic signal of the brand — it forces whitespace between letters, giving headlines a printed-poster cadence. Also used for navigation labels, tags, and the floating nav bar.

bradford.$description: Body and UI face. Tight tracking (0.005–0.027em) at 15–17px for article descriptions, card metadata, button labels, and dense UI chrome. The contrast with LabilVariable's wide tracking is deliberate: LabilVariable announces, Bradford explains. Weight 500 appears for emphasis in metadata and button labels.

labil.$description: Masthead and logo lockup, plus secondary UI labels. A static companion to LabilVariable — same family, different cuts — used where the variable axis isn't needed (wordmark, fixed-size badges).
